# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.2 (09c37a8e)
name: Contractor access review queue
version: "1.0"
settings:
  default_provider: ollama
  providers:
    ollama:
      type: ollama
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
      default_model: qwen3:4b-q4_K_M
  defaults:
    temperature: 0
    max_tokens: 1800
tools:
  - name: check_access
    type: cli
    description: Run the fixed local checker and write output/access-review.csv. Takes no arguments.
    command: "python3 -I check_access.py"
    sandbox:
      type: local_restricted
      resource_limits:
        timeout_sec: 10
agents:
  - name: Runner
    role: worker
    tools: [check_access]
    system_prompt: Call check_access with empty arguments. After success, report the output path. Never infer decisions.
    settings: {max_iterations: 3}
orchestrator:
  name: Access review
  strategy: Pipeline
  agents: [Runner]
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: apply_policy
        agent: Runner
        task: "Call check_access with {}. Report the tool result. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: check_access}
